requirements.text: Users must be able to create a trip and share access with friends.

The app must be usable in a web browser on desktop and mobile screen sizes.

constraints.text: Initial scope should remain simple and focused on core planning workflows.

objective.text: Create a simple web app where friends can suggest activities, vote on options, and generate a shared trip itinerary.

audience.text: Small groups of friends (roughly 3–10 people) planning a single trip together.

scope_in.text: Create trips that a group can use for collaborative planning.
Allow trip participants to suggest activities for the trip.
Allow trip participants to vote on proposed activities.
Generate a shared itinerary from selected activities.
Provide a web-based interface for trip collaboration.

requirements.text: Users must be able to create a trip and share access with friends.
Trip participants must be able to add activity suggestions with at least a title and description.
Trip participants must be able to vote on suggested activities.
The app must present a shared itinerary view for the trip.
The app must be usable in a web browser on desktop and mobile screen sizes.
The prototype must support one trip group of approximately 3–10 participants per trip without requiring admin setup.
